title: Narration — Direct ↔ Indirect Speech
lede: একাডেমির হ্যান্ডনোট অনুযায়ী — Person, Tense ও নিকট্যসূচক শব্দের পরিবর্তন, এবং পাঁচ ধরনের বাক্যের নিয়ম, প্রতিটির উদাহরণসহ।

objectives.t: Split any direct speech into two parts
Pick the reporting verb by sentence type
Know when tense does NOT change
objectives.d: Reporting verb present বা future, আর চিরন্তন সত্য

rules.name: Narration কী, আর দুটি অংশ
rules.bn: বক্তার কথা অন্যের কাছে বর্ণনা করাকে **Narration বা উক্তি** বলে। **Direct Speech** — বক্তার কথা হুবহু তুলে ধরা। **Indirect Speech** — বক্তার কথা নিজের ভাষায় বর্ণনা করা।
rules.formula: Reporting Verb (inverted comma-র বাইরে) + Reported Speech (ভিতরে)
rules.ex: **D:** He said, "I am ill." → **I:** He said ==that he was ill==.

rules.name: Person Change (পুরুষ পরিবর্তন)
rules.bn: **1st Person** (I, we, me, my, our) — Reporting Verb-এর **Subject** অনুযায়ী পরিবর্তন হবে। **2nd Person** (you, your) — Reporting Verb-এর **Object** অনুযায়ী। **3rd Person** (he, she, it, they, নাম) — **কোনো পরিবর্তন হবে না**।
rules.ex: **D:** He said to me, "I know ==your== father." → **I:** He told me that he knew ==my== father.

rules.name: Tense Change (টেন্স পরিবর্তন)
rules.bn: Reporting Verb যদি **Past Tense** (যেমন said) হয়, তবে Reported Speech-এর tense এক ধাপ পিছিয়ে যাবে। **Present Indefinite → Past Indefinite, Present Continuous → Past Continuous, Present Perfect → Past Perfect।**
rules.formula: Present → Past · Past → Past Perfect · shall/will → would · can/may → could/might
rules.ex: **D:** He said, "I ==am== ill." → **I:** He said that he ==was== ill.

rules.name: Tense কখন বদলায় না
rules.bn: Reporting Verb যদি **Present বা Future Tense**-এ থাকে, তবে ভেতরের tense-এর কোনো পরিবর্তন হয় না। **চিরন্তন সত্য বা অভ্যাস** বোঝালেও tense বদলায় না।
rules.formula: Reporting verb = present / future · চিরন্তন সত্য · অভ্যাস
rules.ex: **D:** He says, "I am ill." → **I:** He says that he ==is== ill. · The teacher said, "The sun ==rises== in the east." → … that the sun ==rises== in the east.

rules.name: Word Change (নিকট্যসূচক শব্দের পরিবর্তন)
rules.bn: নিকট্য বোঝানো শব্দগুলো দূরত্ব বোঝানো শব্দে বদলে যায়।
rules.formula: this→that · these→those · here→there · now→then · today→that day
rules.ex: tomorrow → ==the next day== · yesterday → ==the previous day== · ago → ==before==

rules.name: Assertive Sentence (বিবৃতিমূলক বাক্য)
rules.bn: **Reporting Verb:** said বা told বসে (Object থাকলে **told** বসানো ভালো)। **Linker:** Inverted comma উঠে গিয়ে **that** বসে।
rules.formula: Subject + said / told + Object + that + Reported Speech
rules.ex: **D:** He said to me, "I am fine today." → **I:** He ==told me that== he was fine ==that day==.

rules.name: Interrogative Sentence (প্রশ্নবোধক বাক্য)
rules.bn: **Reporting Verb:** asked বা enquired of বসে। **Linker:** **if / whether** বসে; তবে WH Word (what, who, how, where) থাকলে সেটিই বসে। বাক্যটি **Assertive** হয়ে যায় — Subject আগে, Verb পরে।
rules.formula: asked + Object + if / whether / WH-word + Subject + Verb
rules.ex: **D:** He said to me, "Are you reading a book?" → **I:** He ==asked me if== I was reading a book. · "What is your name?" → He asked me ==what my name was==.

rules.name: Imperative Sentence (আদেশ / উপদেশ / অনুরোধ)
rules.bn: **Reporting Verb:** অর্থ অনুযায়ী **ordered** (আদেশ), **requested** (অনুরোধ), **advised** (উপদেশ) বা told বসে। **Linker:** Inverted comma উঠে গিয়ে **to** বসে; negative হলে **not to** বসে।
rules.formula: ordered / requested / advised + Object + to + V1 (negative: not to + V1)
rules.ex: **D:** The teacher said to me, "Do the work." → **I:** The teacher ==ordered me to do== the work. · "Please help me." → He ==requested me to help== him.

rules.name: Optative Sentence (প্রার্থনা বা ইচ্ছাসূচক বাক্য)
rules.bn: **Reporting Verb:** prayed (প্রার্থনা) বা wished (ইচ্ছা) বসে। **Linker:** that বসে। **Structure:** Subject + might/may + verb-এর base form।
rules.formula: prayed / wished + that + Subject + might + V1
rules.ex: **D:** Mother said to me, "May you pass the exam." → **I:** Mother ==prayed that I might pass== the exam.

rules.name: Exclamatory Sentence (আবেগ বা বিস্ময়সূচক বাক্য)
rules.bn: **Reporting Verb:** **exclaimed with joy** (আনন্দে), **exclaimed with sorrow** (দুঃখে), বা **exclaimed with wonder** (বিস্ময়ে) বসে। **Linker:** that। বাক্যটি Assertive হয়ে যায় এবং **very / great** যুক্ত হয়।
rules.formula: exclaimed with joy / sorrow / wonder + that + Assertive form
rules.ex: **D:** The boy said, "Hurrah! I have won the game." → **I:** The boy ==exclaimed with joy that== he had won the game. · "What a beautiful bird it is!" → He ==exclaimed with wonder that it was a very beautiful bird==.

drills.title: Practice Set 1 — Person, Tense, Word
drills.intro: তিনটি পরিবর্তন — কে বলছে, কোন tense, আর কোন শব্দ।

items.q: He said, "I am ill."
items.ans: He said that he was ill.

items.q: He said to me, "I know your father."
items.ans: He told me that he knew my father.

items.q: He says, "I am ill."
items.ans: He says that he is ill.
items.why: Reporting verb present → tense বদলায় না। (নিয়ম ০৪)

items.q: The teacher said, "The sun rises in the east."
items.ans: The teacher said that the sun rises in the east.

items.q: He said, "I am busy today."
items.ans: He said that he was busy that day.

items.q: He said, "I will come tomorrow."
items.ans: He said that he would come the next day.
items.why: will → would; tomorrow → the next day। (নিয়ম ০৩, ০৫)

items.q: She said, "I saw him here yesterday."
items.ans: She said that she had seen him there the previous day.
items.why: Past → Past Perfect; here → there; yesterday → the previous day। (নিয়ম ০৩, ০৫)

drills.title: Practice Set 2 — পাঁচ ধরনের বাক্য
drills.intro: আগে বাক্যের ধরন বলো — তারপর reporting verb আর linker।

items.q: He said to me, "I am fine today."
items.ans: He told me that he was fine that day.

items.q: He said to me, "Are you reading a book?"
items.ans: He asked me if I was reading a book.

items.q: He said to me, "What is your name?"
items.ans: He asked me what my name was.
items.why: WH প্রশ্ন → WH word-ই linker; subject আগে, verb পরে। (নিয়ম ০৭)

items.q: The teacher said to me, "Do the work."
items.ans: The teacher ordered me to do the work.

items.q: He said to me, "Please help me."
items.ans: He requested me to help him.

items.q: Father said to me, "Do not waste time."
items.ans: Father advised me not to waste time.

items.q: Mother said to me, "May you pass the exam."
items.ans: Mother prayed that I might pass the exam.

items.q: The boy said, "Hurrah! I have won the game."
items.ans: The boy exclaimed with joy that he had won the game.

items.q: He said, "What a beautiful bird it is!"
items.ans: He exclaimed with wonder that it was a very beautiful bird.

items.q: She said, "Alas! I am undone."
items.ans: She exclaimed with sorrow that she was undone.

items.q: He said, "I am ill."

items.q: He said to me, "I am fine today."

items.why: WH word-ই linker; **subject আগে, verb পরে**। (নিয়ম ০৭)

items.q: The teacher said to me, "Do the work."

items.q: He said to me, "Please help me."

items.ans: He exclaimed with wonder that it was a very beautiful bird.

items.ans: The teacher said that the sun rises in the east.

extras.title: বাক্যের ধরন → Reporting verb ও Linker — এক নজরে

tips.d: বাক্যটি Assertive, Interrogative, Imperative, Optative না Exclamatory — এটি ঠিক করলেই reporting verb ও linker বেরিয়ে আসে।
==S==ubject অনুযায়ী 1st person, ==O==bject অনুযায়ী 2nd person, 3rd person-এ ==N==o change।
Reporting verb ==present/future== হলে, বা ==চিরন্তন সত্য== হলে ভিতরের tense অপরিবর্তিত থাকে।
Indirect-এ ==subject আগে, verb পরে== — ‘what my name was’, ‘what was my name’ নয়।
আদেশে ==ordered==, অনুরোধে ==requested==, উপদেশে ==advised== — অর্থ দেখে verb বাছবে।
‘What a beautiful bird!’ → ‘it was a ==very== beautiful bird’ — very যোগ করতে ভুলো না।

recap: Narration-এর দুই অংশ: Reporting Verb ও Reported Speech।
তিনটি পরিবর্তন: Person (SON), Tense (এক ধাপ পিছিয়ে), Word (this→that, here→there)।
Reporting verb present/future বা চিরন্তন সত্য হলে tense বদলায় না।
Assertive → said/told + that; Interrogative → asked + if/whether/WH।
Optative → prayed/wished + that + might; Exclamatory → exclaimed with joy/sorrow/wonder + that।
homework: Tense পরিবর্তনের ৮টি সারি না দেখে লিখে আনবে।
Word Change-এর ৭টি জোড়া মুখস্থ করে আসবে।
Practice Set 2-এর ১০টি বাক্য খাতায় সমাধান করবে।
